test_index_of_float_series: test Series.index_of() with float32 and float64 series handling NaN, inf, and -0.0 values
test_index_of_integer_series: test Series.index_of() across all integer types including min and max boundary values
test_index_of_groupby: test using Expr.index_of() as an aggregation within group_by operations on DataFrames
test_index_of_null_and_empty: test Series.index_of() with null dtype series and empty series returning None
test_index_of_various_types: test Series.index_of() with strings, bools, datetime, time, timedelta, lists, arrays, structs, decimals, enums, categoricals, and binary
